subject.title: fix(reconcile): escalate stuck review placeholders on pull requests

question: Should this workflow receive the additional pull-request write grant after an in-org run confirms the GitHub App installation token can label a stranded pull request as intended?
rationale: The source change is mechanically small, but only repository operators can exercise the organization’s GitHub App installation token and accept its expanded permission boundary.

options.title: Verify then merge
options.body: Run the reconciliation workflow against a controlled stranded pull request, retain redacted output showing a successful label write, and merge if the issue path remains unchanged.

options.title: Pause for token-scope review
options.body: Keep the PR open if repository owners want to reconsider whether a separate narrower token or recovery design should handle pull-request labels.

recommendation.title: Verify then merge
recommendation.body: Run the reconciliation workflow against a controlled stranded pull request, retain redacted output showing a successful label write, and merge if the issue path remains unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the production diagnosis and controlled permission evidence, so they are the best available routing contact for reproducing the requested workflow proof.
